commits.headline: fix(tools): only @ps2as files assemble their assembly blocks apart
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Sony's 2.9-ee driver reads the GNU assembler macros the INCLUDE_ASM
files use (rac3-uya-decomp built its libgcc files that way), so an @ee29
file compiles as one unit, assembly blocks included: splitting them off
broke the static functions of the libgcc files once they are C again.
Only SN's Ps2EeAs cannot read the macros, so only @ps2as files put their
assembly blocks in a GNU as slice of their own.

commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:

i5bootn (13cf5c5): the loader's code, the Sony library files (@ee29) and
the libgcc modules, built from GCC's source. i5bootn's .text is the US

commits.body:

commits.headline: docs: the beta disc, the port's results, the discs by serial
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
docs/BETA.md: what the July 2004 beta (TCES_524.56) offers. Its main
program is uncompressed, with linker-written section headers but no
symbols. Its core links the online libraries (30 CVS headers), and it
has more assert and host0: debug text than retail. 796 of boot_elf's
2,140 functions of six words or more are also in it, with the same
compiler output. Nothing from the beta is committed.

docs/porting.md gets the C step and its numbers: 2,410 of the US
project's 3,315 C functions carried;…
